author: tbolt
description: A lean, local-first firearms and ammunition inventory. Track every firearm with round counts, cleaning intervals, accuracy by load, and magazine spring service; count rounds on hand by caliber with rotation reminders for carry ammo; and manage reloading components, recipes, buildable counts, and per-round costs. Data lives on your NAS.
tagline: Your safe, the rounds in it, and the load book, self-hosted

tips.before_install:
## Armory

Data (firearms, ammunition, reloading components, load recipes, magazines, and your range log) is stored on your ZimaOS disk at `/DATA/AppData/armory/`, so it survives container rebuilds and is shared across every browser on your network.

title: Armory
release_note: - Initial release: self-hosted firearms & ammunition inventory with on-NAS storage.
